name: Anantara Chiang Mai Resort
positioning: Riverside city resort on the Mae Ping River in Chiang Mai, designed by Kerry Hill around the 1921 House, the former British consulate
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet riverside base a short ride from Chiang Mai's Old Town
Long stays and families using serviced suites with kitchens

facts.text: The resort is located on the banks of the Mae Ping River.
The resort is a short tuk tuk ride from Chiang Mai's Old Town and is hidden behind a bamboo wall.
The resort centres on the 1921 House, the former British consulate, built over a century ago.
All accommodations have large terraces furnished with daybeds.
Deluxe rooms have a balcony or terrace overlooking the garden or river.
Serviced suites, suited to long stays and families, are across the road, linked by a walkway, with full use of the resort's services and facilities.
Serviced suites have a kitchen, laundry, and dining, living and work spaces.
Anantara Spa offers daily wellness activities, traditional Thai healing and IV drips.
The spa offers a mix of Lanna-inspired rituals and Western treatments.
The resort offers muay Thai and Spice Spoons cooking classes.
Afternoon tea is served each day on the verandah of the 1921 House.
Several of the city's markets are nearby, including the Saturday and Sunday Markets and the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar.

highlights.text: Daily river cruises depart from the resort's private pier.
The infinity pool is surrounded by lily ponds and loungers and overlooks the river.
Pool Suites have a private plunge pool and a cabana, with privileges that include in-suite check-in and a floating breakfast.
The complex was designed by the late Australian architect Kerry Hill.
A Street Wise Guru can lead insider tours of lesser-known markets and temples, traditional coffee houses and street food stalls.

considerations.text: There is no Kids Club, but activities are offered for children.
There are no connecting rooms, but guests may request adjoining rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
